newsitem.title: USA: Oneita expects to incur oper loss in Q2.
newsitem.headline: Oneita expects to incur oper loss in Q2.

text.p: Oneita Industries Inc said Friday it expected to incur an operating loss in the second quarter of its 1997 fiscal year.

The company said the unit selling price that it received for its products had been deteriorating. "The demand for Oneita's products continues to be weak due to seasonality of the business and to excess production capacity within the industry," it said.
The company said it was expanding its distribution channels within its "manufacturing capabilities" as part of cost-reduction program to improve its competitiveness.
Oneita, which makes sports clothing, reported a first-quarter loss of $0.65 a share against a loss of $0.49 a year ago.
